A.note: The deck is clean and well organised. It has a table of contents, a governance chart, an enrollment-by-area table, a timeline and requests to the education office, and the overall flow holds together. However, it has no budget results, which are central to this report, and only a few figures. The '우리 학교' placeholder and the '가상 수치' labels show the numbers are made up, and the chart slides are left fairly empty.

B.note: Over 13 slides it covers participation, results by area and grade, monthly trends, budget spending, satisfaction, best practices, problems and 2027 plans, with charts and real-looking figures, so it is very complete. However, every slide carries a red 'replace with real figures' warning. The headline titles are small and pushed to the top-left, and the budget table and chart labels are small, so some text is hard to read.
